title: Trumpet and the bands he played with, including Manuel Perez
summary: Trumpet was his only instrument. He lists the bands he played in, played accordion duets with Fess Manetta, and worked in Perez's orchestra then the Onward Brass Band.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Well the first, the only one was the trumpet. It was the only instrument I played, was trumpet. And I played with different bands, you know, like Buddy P.D., Sam Morgan, Chris Kelly, and a lot of jazz bands. And I played with Manuel Perez, Tuxedo Brass Band, Armwood Brass Band, and I also played with Fess Mineta. And Al J.
Tell about that, when you used to play with him.

Oh, him and I used to play, he had the accordion, you know. And he'd come down home and pick me up, and him and I would go out on there and play, you know, little parties, you know, to get together, you know, like that.

Yeah, we played in the orchestra on the Parisian roof garden, with Emmanuel Perez's band. And then after we left there, why, uh, uh, Emmanuel and I made a brass band up together, the Armwood Brass Band.
